game.title: Green Bay Packers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

lede: Green Bay Packers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#13 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tampa Bay Buccaneers +0.8 with a fair total of 45.9 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Green Bay Packers pass offence vs Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass defence, which sits +0.172 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
